title: Verify formal BIT QUERY 349 removal (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and scope

The exact #7001 paired BIT caller still gives the prescribed arbitrary-input diagonal if the second LOCAL of every stage changes to `(x,y) → (D_s qx,D_s(x+y))` and QUERY 349 becomes an ordinary ADD. All 1,444 coefficients pass in each direction. This is a formal caller identity and raw price preflight. **κ change is 0%.** The exact comparator #7161 is 0.003644890067940. A full physical provider, fixed-tape admission and a compatible complex supplier remain open.

## Inputs and price

Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, exact #7001 caller and #6726 native word. The source pins cover the literal caller, full predecessor ledger and retained native word. Reconstruct all native and caller rank invoices from these inputs. Removing QUERY 349 frees 111 paid rank-one jobs. At κ = 10018846261809/2500000000000000, charging 36 new rank-one jobs across the 18 changed calls leaves +14.89610078085 raw moment. Charging 54 misses by −3.10389921915. The price is conditional on constructing and fully charging the new provider.

Task scope changes the BIT helper card to an exact caller phase reassignment. #7001 and #6980 provide the retained query-only schedule. The changed LOCAL and matching diagonal are new within this checked scope. The [Round 12 checkpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19537983) records the first physical pilot and its price gap. The separate documentation-only prerequisite reuses the selected replay navigation from #7161 to pass the repository's hosted planning check.

## Clean replay

CPython 3.12 with assertions and no external packages.

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-bit-query349-formal-caller
~~~

Local registered replay, metadata and commit-byte/mode/source-history checks passed. The old endpoint passes. Reverting one changed LOCAL and keeping QUERY 349 fail in both directions, and a changed caller byte is rejected. Six navigation tests pass with the documented prerequisite. The changed all-width provider, compiler, complete application and historical cold replay were outside this package's verification scope.

## Credit and next test

Credit #6726 for the native word, #6834 for the paired invoice, #6980 for the query-only schedule, #7001 for the exact E-free caller, and #7113 for directed-cost precedent. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. Start the next provider test at a live nested frame in the port-0 source and backup path. It must preserve the exact source response, all helper rows and physical output gauges, and fit the fully charged allowance.
